name: Sandwurm Convergence
oracle_text:
Creatures with flying can't attack you or planeswalkers you control.
At the beginning of your end step, create a 5/5 green Wurm creature token.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, create a 5/5 green Wurm creature token.

needs.what: a 5/5 green Wurm creature token with no abilities (token id wurm_5_5_g)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Wurm token at all; the nearest 5/5s are dragon_5_5_r_flying and elemental_5_5_rg, which differ in colour, creature type and (for the Dragon) flying. The rest of the card is expressible: the first line is a cant_attack_you static with affects {"controller": "any", "keywords": ["flying"]} (planeswalkers are covered by default, no player_only), and the trigger is end_step with controller you feeding create_token.
